user_config_path.description: Optional path to user-specific birdtray config file (e.g., ~/.config/birdtray.cfg). When empty, uses default location (~/.config/birdtray.cfg).

debug_dumpmork_file.description: Path to a Thunderbird Mork (.msf) file for diagnostic dump via --dumpmork. One-shot debugging only; not a runtime configuration.

autostart_enabled.description: Whether to enable session autostart via desktop environment tools (not systemd).
